children: The SENSEX Index decreased 330 points or 0.44 percent on Tuesday to close at 74529 points.
The decline was led by Nestle India (-1.36%), Bajaj Finserv (-1.23%) and Bajaj Finance (-1.21%).
On the upside, the strongest performers were Titan Company (1.52%), Eternal Limited (1.39%) and Tata Steel (0.79%).

title: The SENSEX Index Closes 0.44% Lower
